svg.title: IGEL AI hybrid architecture — 5-layer agent system adapted for IGEL test generation
svg.desc: Five-layer architecture showing CLAUDE.md memory layer, IGEL Skills knowledge layer, Validation Gates guardrail layer, Subagents delegation layer, and Plugins distribution layer. IGEL Knowledge Sources on left feed into each layer. Agent Teams on right consume outputs.

g.text: IGEL AI test generation — hybrid architecture v3.1
RAG + Knowledge Graph + Validation Gates + Feedback Loop + Claude Code Agent

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What IGEL knowledge sources feed into the pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How do the IGEL agent teams consume the pipeline outputs?')
sendPrompt('What goes in IGEL CLAUDE.md — the memory layer?')
sendPrompt('What IGEL Skills are in the knowledge layer?')
g.text: On-demand. Modular context chunks. Description-matched, auto-invoked per TC type.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Which validation gates are in the hooks layer and what do they check?')
g.text: PreToolUse: block hardcoded creds + prod URL

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do the IGEL subagents delegate work?')
g.text: No recursion — subagents cannot spawn subagents. Results returned to main agent only.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What IGEL plugins are distributed to the team?')
g.text: Install once — team gets CLAUDE.md + Skills + Gates + Agent configs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the feedback loop close — from execution back to ingestion?')
g.text: Execution failures + human corrections + rejections feed into kb_feedback table
Analyzer publishes: retrieval boost list + prompt patches + blacklist patterns
Applied automatically on next generation run — system improves every 50 feedback entries
